from app.api.handlers import handle_normalize_date as h

cases = [
    ({"date": "2024-03-05"}, (200, {"date": "2024-03-05"})),
    ({"date": "5 Mar 2024"}, (200, {"date": "2024-03-05"})),
    ({"date": "March 5, 2024"}, (200, {"date": "2024-03-05"})),
    ({"date": "05/03/2024"}, (200, {"date": "2024-03-05"})),
    ({"date": "  2024-03-05  "}, (200, {"date": "2024-03-05"})),
    ({"date": "21 Dec 1999"}, (200, {"date": "1999-12-21"})),
    ({"date": "December 21, 1999"}, (200, {"date": "1999-12-21"})),
    ({"date": "29/02/2024"}, (200, {"date": "2024-02-29"})),
    ({"date": "2024-02-29"}, (200, {"date": "2024-02-29"})),
    # invalid
    ({}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": None}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": 20240305}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "2023-02-29"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "31/02/2024"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "2024-13-01"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "2024-3-5"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "5 Foo 2024"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "Foo 5, 2024"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "3/5/2024"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": ""}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "not a date"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "2024-03-05T00:00:00"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "5 March 2024"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
    ({"date": "Mar 5, 2024"}, (400, {"error": "invalid date"})),
]
ok = True
for inp, exp in cases:
    got = h(inp)
    status = "OK " if got == exp else "FAIL"
    if got != exp:
        ok = False
    print(status, inp, "->", got, "" if got == exp else f"(expected {exp})")
print("ALL OK" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
